_doc: Fleet roster. min_mib/pref_mib = vLLM memory budget per GPU (weights + KV); tp = tensor parallel; quant = vLLM --quantization (null = checkpoint precision). All replicas of one model use the same settings so load-balanced results are consistent. target = desired replicas (watchdog fills up to it, small models first in big slots only if nothing larger fits). Order = launch priority.
